newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Esso further develops Malaysian field.
newsitem.headline: Esso further develops Malaysian field.

text.p: Esso Production Malaysia Inc said on Wednesday it has started an infill drilling programme on the Tapis D platform, off northeast Terengganu state.
The programme involved drilling nine infill wells and was expected to add more than 10,000 barrels of oil to daily production, the company said in a statement.
Esso Production Malaysia is an affiliate of Exxon Corp of the United States.
The Tapis field, covering about 85 square kilometres, produces 24,500 barrels of oil a day at present.
The infill programme -- drilling of additional wells between existing wells -- is now at the half-way mark and was scheduled to be completed by the end of the year, it said.
The field is a joint venture between Esso and Petronas Carigali, a unit of Malaysian state oil company Petronas.
Steve Kirchhoff, Esso Production Malaysia engineering manager, said the drilling opportunities were recognised through a joint study by the company and Petronas Carigali.
Esso operates 26 platforms in eight producing fields off the Terengganu coast producing 300,000 barrels of oil and 900 million cubic feet of gas per day.
Production on the Tapis field started in 1978 and has grown to four platforms.
